method: One reading of the saved title and body with arm, source assignment, seeds, grade and position hidden. Unit includes the scope of a specific search or cancellation action. Recheck requires an explicit direction to check or obtain a named current fact or permission. Reporting what an agent previously verified or respecting an already given permission alone does not qualify. Exact passages support each positive code.
